subject: MAP Kickoff: private deployment — VPC topology, VPN, IAM/KMS owners, and timeline
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood-inference.com>
To: Sam Torres <sam.torres@zenrise.ai>, Julia Park <julia@zenrise.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP Kickoff: private deployment — VPC topology, VPN, IAM/KMS owners, and timeline

Hi Sam and Julia,

Thanks again for the productive pilot sessions last week. As discussed in the call, wed like to kick off a short Mutual Action Plan focused on your Private deployment (VPC + on-prem gateway option) so we can align roles, confirm network topology, and lock the close timeline. My ask in this email is threefold:

1) Introductions & owners: please confirm the ZenRise owners for network/VPN, IAM/KMS, and security/compliance. Ive looped in our internal owners below.
2) MAP milestones: I attached a working MAP (mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx) — please review the proposed milestones and dates; suggest any changes.
3) Next steps: can we schedule a 60-minute technical kickoff this week to walk the network diagram and handshake on the VPN approach?

Quick owner roster (Redwood):
- Soojin Lee — Solutions (MAP lead, program owner)
- Vivek Kulkarni — Infrastructure (private deployment routing, VPN)
- Rishi Malhotra — Security & Compliance (KMS, encryption, SOC2 evidence)
- Marissa Cole — Customer Success (onboarding plan & runbook)

Proposed high-level MAP and target close:
- Week 0 (this week): MAP review + technical kickoff (network diagram, VPN options, IAM model)
- Week 1: Customer provides network CIDR, peering constraints, and KMS/HSM details; Redwood provides deployment topology diagram and firewall rule template
- Week 2: Test connectivity (VPN or Transit), smoke inference runs in staging, complete security questionnaire items
- Week 3: Final validation and rollout plan; sign-off and production cutover target

Targeting a three-week timeline to production cutover (editable depending on your change-window and procurement). Attachments: network_diagram_v1.png (placeholder), mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx, soc2_scope.pdf.

Can you reply with the ZenRise owners for: networking/VPN, IAM/KMS, and the person who will own the procurement/PO? Once we confirm owners Ill update the MAP and send calendar invites.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,

Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood-inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0172

Attachment stubs: [network_diagram_v1.png (image/png)], [mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)], [soc2_scope.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@zenrise.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Julia Park <julia@zenrise.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: private deployment — VPC topology, VPN, IAM/KMS owners, and timeline

Soojin,

Thanks — this looks great and the timeline seems realistic. Quick answers from our side:
- Networking/VPN owner: Julia Park (cc'd)
- IAM/KMS owner: Michael Du (michael.du@zenrise.ai) — he is on the security team (I'll add him to the thread shortly)
- Procurement/PO: Sam Torres (me) — I own the procurement and vendor onboarding checklist.

We reviewed the MAP and added a couple of comments in the sheet (bandwidth expectations and maintenance windows). Wed prefer a Tuesday technical kickoff if possible (we have maintenance windows on Thursdays). Attached is our current network diagram with VLANs and peering constraints (network_diagram_env_zenrise.png).

Can you confirm whether Redwood supports IPsec VPN to our on-prem edge (Cisco ASA) or if you recommend a cloud-transit (AWS TGW) approach for the initial cutover?

Sam
Director of IT Operations
ZenRise AI
sam.torres@zenrise.ai
+1 (206) 555-0129

Attachment: [network_diagram_env_zenrise.png (image/png)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>
To: Sam Torres <sam.torres@zenrise.ai>, Julia Park <julia@zenrise.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 08:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: private deployment — VPC topology, VPN, IAM/KMS owners, and timeline

Hi Sam / Julia — thanks for the quick response and the network diagram.

Short answers:
- We support both IPsec site-to-site VPN (customer-managed edge) and AWS Transit Gateway (TGW) peering depending on ease of routing and throughput. For initial rollout, TGW peer is often faster to get into staging but IPsec is fine if you prefer to keep traffic through your edge.
- We will prepare a firewall rule template and a CIDR mapping document by EOD tomorrow.

Action items Im taking on (Vivek):
- Produce a draft VPC topology that maps to your diagram and includes subnets for inference workers, control plane, and secure management plane (deliverable: topology_v1.png) — ETA: 48 hours
- Provide IPsec configuration snippets and MTU recommendations if you choose Cisco ASA — ETA: 48 hours

Rishi, please start the SOC2 evidence checklist and confirm whether the requested items in soc2_scope.pdf are already covered by our standard Private offering. Marissa, Ill sync with you on onboarding runbook tasks once topology is finalized.

Soojin, I can take Tuesday 10:00–11:00 PT for the 60-minute ICEbreaker/tech kickoff if that works for ZenRise.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Principal Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood-inference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Sam Torres <sam.torres@zenrise.ai>, Julia Park <julia@zenrise.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood-inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 15:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: private deployment — VPC topology, VPN, IAM/KMS owners, and timeline

Hi all — following up to lock calendar and owners. Per thread:

- Technical kickoff scheduled: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 — 10:00–11:00 PT (invites sent)
- Owners confirmed: Julia (networking/VPN), Michael Du (IAM/KMS — added), Sam (procurement PO), Soojin (MAP owner), Vivek (infra lead), Rishi (security lead), Marissa (CS lead)
- Deliverables and owners (short):
  * topology_v1.png — Vivek (48h)
  * IPsec config + ASA notes — Vivek (48h)
  * SOC2 evidence checklist status — Rishi (48h)
  * MAP v1 with updated dates/comments — Soojin (EOD tomorrow)
  * Onboarding runbook draft — Marissa (post-topology)

Sam/Julia — thanks for attaching the ZenRise diagram and the comments in the MAP. Well incorporate bandwidth notes and the maintenance window constraint. I uploaded a working MAP and the draft topology to the shared drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1x-example-MAP-ZenRise (see MAP/v1 tab).

If anything changes on your side before Tuesday please flag here; otherwise well walk the diagram and the MAP in the kickoff meeting.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
